Files have a 0.15 s lead-in copied from the loop tail and a 0.6 s tail copied from the loop head, so a decoder that ignores the edit list (1024-sample priming) still loops cleanly - only both points shift by 1024/48000 s. Use AudioBufferSourceNode.loop with loopStart/loopEnd and start(0, loopStart).
